summary: FINAL Phase 3 acceptance test PASSED. Backend-only run: 49/49 tests pass (Phase2 26/26 + Phase3 15/15 + new acceptance suite 8/8). The full hero flow OPEN->IN_REVIEW->REMEDIATION->(RESOLVE-without-evidence=400)->remediation completed->(still 400)->evidence attached->RESOLVED->(same-user VERIFIED=403 SoD)->COMPLIANCE VERIFIED all executed serially. Evidence Package generated twice for the same 2026-01-01..2026-03-31 period and the canonical SHA-256 is IDENTICAL, confirming deterministic canonical JSON. Auditor GETs on /evidence, /evidence-packages, /audit-logs succeed and every operational write (assign/transition/remediation/comment/evidence/package generate) is denied. Viewer GET /audit-logs -> 403. Audit endpoint has no PUT/PATCH/DELETE handlers (append-only, verified via source scan + HTTP method probes returning 405). No Stellar private-key/Keypair usage in /app/backend production code. Package stellar block: verification_status=NOT_SUBMITTED, transaction_hash=None, ledger=None, stellar_account is a 'Not submitted — conceptual integrity layer (no keys, no broadcast)' placeholder string (not a real Stellar account). Evidence chain returns the required 8 steps with correct labels. KPIs derive from records: evidence_readiness>=1, at least one VERIFIED exception present, open_remediation reduced.

minor.issue: Ordering nit: illegal-state check runs BEFORE the role check, so an AUDITOR attempting to transition a terminal-state exception receives 400 instead of 403. Not a security regression (auditor still cannot mutate state and the endpoint uses require_perm-equivalent via can() guard), but the acceptance criterion prefers 403 for role-denied writes. Recommend moving the `can(user['role'], 'exception:transition')` role gate to the top of the handler (before ALLOWED_NEXT check).

action_items: Optional (minor): in api.py transition_exception, evaluate `can(user['role'], 'exception:transition')` before the ALLOWED_NEXT check so role-denied writes always return 403 rather than 400 when the target transition happens to be illegal.
critical_code_review_comments: api.py:337 transition endpoint uses `get_current_user` and gates roles internally via can(); state check runs before role check causing the 400-vs-403 nit above. Consider a require_perm-style dep pre-gate that still allows the VERIFIED SoD branch.
api.py:498 generate_package still to_list(20000) for tx and to_list(2000) for exceptions — acceptable for demo but should stream/aggregate before scale.

Stellar block returns a natural-language placeholder in stellar_account/transaction_hash/network fields; consider using explicit null fields plus a top-level `notice` string, so consumers don't need to parse prose to decide 'not submitted'.
